title: Tesla seeks Taiwan chip engineers for Terafab project
title_zh: 特斯拉为 Terafab 项目寻找台湾芯片工程师
summary: Tesla is seeking semiconductor engineers in Taiwan for its Terafab artificial intelligence chip complex, ‌according to job postings on its website.
summary_zh: 根据其网站上的招聘信息，特斯拉正在台湾为其 Terafab 人工智能芯片综合体寻找半导体工程师。

title: ICE Director Lyons to Depart in May After Tumultuous Tenure
title_zh: ICE 主管 Lyons 在经历了动荡的任期后将于 5 月离职
summary: (Bloomberg) -- The acting head of US Immigration and Customs Enforcement will leave the agency at the end of May after a tumultuous year managing President Donald Trump’s mass arrest and deportation campaign.Todd Lyons has been the agency’s acting head since March 2025.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——美国移民和海关执法局代理负责人将于 5 月底离开该机构，此前他管理了唐纳德·特朗普总统的大规模逮捕和驱逐行动，经历了动荡的一年。托德·莱昂斯自 2025 年 3 月起一直担任该机构的代理负责人。

title: Stock market today: S&P 500, Nasdaq, Dow futures climb as Israel-Lebanon agree to 10-day ceasefire
title_zh: 今日股市：随着以色列和黎巴嫩同意为期 10 天的停火，标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克指数和道琼斯指数期货上涨
summary: Major stock gauges have risen overnight as potential peace talks calm instability fears that have rocked markets for weeks.
summary_zh: 由于潜在的和平谈判平息了数周来震撼市场的不稳定担忧，主要股指一夜之间上涨。

title: S&P 500, Nasdaq edge up to new records on Middle East hopes
title_zh: 中东希望拉动标普 500 指数和纳斯达克指数再创新高

title: NiSource signs long-term power deal with Alphabet, expands Amazon agreement
title_zh: NiSource 与 Alphabet 签署长期电力协议，扩大亚马逊协议
summary: U.S. utility NiSource said on Thursday it had signed a long-term energy supply agreement with a unit ‌of Alphabet to support a large data center in northern ‌Indiana.
summary_zh: 美国公用事业公司 NiSource 周四表示，已与 Alphabet 旗下子公司签署了一项长期能源供应协议，以支持印第安纳州北部的一个大型数据中心。

title: Google, CoreWeave Fuel AI Funding Frenzy With $6.7 Billion Bonds
title_zh: 谷歌和 CoreWeave 发行 67 亿美元债券助推人工智能融资狂潮
summary: (Bloomberg) -- There’s no stopping the artificial intelligence financing boom, with a record deal involving Google-backed data centers and an add-on sale by cloud infrastructure firm CoreWeave Inc. raising a combined $6.7 billion in new junk debt.
summary_zh: (彭博社)——人工智能融资热潮势不可挡，谷歌支持的数据中心达成创纪录的交易，云基础设施公司 CoreWeave Inc. 进行了附加销售，总共筹集了 67 亿美元的新垃圾债。

title: SpaceX Moves Up Vesting Schedule for Employee Shares Before IPO
title_zh: SpaceX 提前 IPO 前员工股票的行权时间表
summary: (Bloomberg) -- SpaceX has moved up a scheduled vesting date for shares awarded to employees to as soon as next week, according to people familiar with the matter, ahead of an IPO targeted to value the company at more than $2 trillion.The company told employees the vesting date...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——据知情人士透露，SpaceX 已将授予员工的股票的预定兑现日期最早推迟到下周，在首次公开募股之前，该公司的估值将超过 2 万亿美元。该公司告诉员工兑现日期...

title: Apple, Google Offer 'Nudify' Apps Despite Policies Against Them
title_zh: 苹果、谷歌不顾政策推出“裸体”应用

title: What the S&P 500 might be telling us
title_zh: 标准普尔 500 指数可能告诉我们什么
summary: Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre goes over Thursday's intraday market action, including a check-in on the S&P 500 (^GSPC). Watch the video above to learn more.
summary_zh: 雅虎金融市场和数据编辑 Jared Blikre 回顾了周四的盘中市场走势，包括对标准普尔 500 指数 (^GSPC) 的检查。观看上面的视频以了解更多信息。
